note: Explicit scope allowlist for MiniMax/owner task branches. The scope check reads THIS FILE FROM THE BASE COMMIT (origin/<base>), never from the pull request head, so a task branch cannot widen its own scope in the same pull request. Extending a scope therefore needs a reviewed change that lands before the next task PR.
common_allow_note: Every task branch may write its own documentation under docs/. The shared denylist above always wins over both common_allow and a task scope: it encodes the general prohibitions of the GA backlog (no canon, no changes to the existing AGENTS/CLAUDE/SKILL, no edits to the Codex contract specs).
